page.content:
Three-horned ceratopsian that shared Hell Creek with T. rex.

How Triceratops connects

  • Topic: Ceratopsia — Triceratops is the latest Cretaceous giant ceratopsian.
  • Location: Hell Creek Formation — Triceratops is the common large herbivore of Hell Creek.
  • Item: Tyrannosaurus rex — T. rex and Triceratops are documented predator and prey in Hell Creek.

What is Triceratops?

Triceratops is the common large herbivore of the latest Cretaceous northern plains, its frill and brow horns the counterpart to tyrannosaur bonebeds in the same formations.

Key threads lead to Ceratopsia, Hell Creek Formation and Tyrannosaurus rex.
